title: statice limonium subsp. behen
intro: Statice limonium subsp. behen, commonly known as Orache, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Chenopodiaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its high content of fiber and antioxidants. Statice limonium subsp. behen has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic actions, such as treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
